Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring at least one school day per year of instruction in the United States Constitution and the Declaration of Independence.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to compulsory study of the United StatesConstitution and the Declaration of Independence; and amending RCW28A.230.170.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 28A.230.170 and 1985 c 341 s 1 are each amended toread as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The study of the Constitution of the United States and theConstitution of the state of Washington shall be a conditionprerequisite to graduation from the public and private high schools ofthis state. The state board of education acting upon the advice of thesuperintendent of public instruction shall provide by rule ((orregulation)) for the implementation of this section. Students in kindergarten through grade twelve shall receive atleast one school day per year of instruction in the United StatesConstitution and the Declaration of Independence.
